title: Patch: the 20-game daily cap holds under simultaneous challenges, seeks and accepts
thread:
**Issue #3842 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3842: Patch: the 20-game daily cap holds under simultaneous challenges, seeks and accepts
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

A follow-up to daily games (#3727, merged in #3762), found in its review and left out of it. Part of the tracker #3726.

### What happens

A player may hold at most `DAILY_MAX_ACTIVE_GAMES` (20) running games, open seeks and open challenges together (R3727004). [`has_room`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/crates/server/src/daily/invites.rs#L82-L88) (`crates/server/src/daily/invites.rs:83`) counts them in one database transaction and commits it; the new challenge, seek or game is written in a later one ([lines 180](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/crates/server/src/daily/invites.rs#L180), [254](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/crates/server/src/daily/invites.rs#L254) and [338](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/crates/server/src/daily/invites.rs#L338)). Several requests sent at the same moment each see 19, and all succeed, so a player can go past 20.

### What should happen

However many requests arrive at once, a player never holds more than `DAILY_MAX_ACTIVE_GAMES`; the ones past it answer `409 daily_full`.

### How to reproduce

With 19 held, send several challenge (or seek, or accept) requests in parallel. More than one succeeds, and the count goes past 20.

### Fix

Count and insert in the same transaction while holding a per-player lock, for example `select … from public.profiles where id = $1 for update` or `pg_advisory_xact_lock`, in `crates/server/src/db/pg.rs`. Keep the in-memory fake (`crates/server/src/db/fake.rs`) matching, and add a case to `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs` that fails without it (two transactions racing for the twentieth place: one wins, one is refused).

If it needs a migration (a trigger, say), take the next free number after `0089` and register it in `crates/server/src/db/migrate.rs`, `crates/server/tests/store/migrations_pinned.rs` (the test prints the checksum to pin) and both lists in `crates/server/tests/sql/run.sh`.

Rated hard: concurrency in the store, the Postgres store and the fake kept in step, and possibly a migration.
```
